entities.summary: Hanke Gerdina Johannette Bruins Slot is a Dutch politician and military veteran who served as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations from 2022 to 2023 and Minister of Foreign Affairs from 2023 until 2024. She is a member of the Christian Democratic Appeal (CDA).
